name: Whisper
description: OpenAI's multilingual encoder-decoder speech model (tiny through large-v3, incl. large-v3-turbo); the de facto reference ASR foundation, with an official PyTorch implementation and CLI.

name: whisper-large-v3
description: OpenAI Whisper large-v3 weights on Hugging Face; the strongest full Whisper checkpoint before the turbo distillation.

name: whisper-large-v3-turbo
description: Distilled, ~8x-faster variant of Whisper large-v3 with near-parity accuracy; drop-in checkpoint for the HF transformers pipeline.

name: Distil-Whisper large-v3
description: Hugging Face distilled Whisper large-v3: 6x faster, 49% smaller, ~1% WER gap; long-form compatible.

name: Distil-Whisper large-v3.5
description: Updated Distil-Whisper distillation targeting improved short-form accuracy.

name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
description: NVIDIA's 0.6B transducer ASR model (TDT decoder); top open English accuracy. Weights CC-BY-4.0 (attribution required).

name: Parakeet RNN-T 0.6B
description: RNN-T variant of Parakeet 0.6B for streaming-friendly transducer decoding. Weights CC-BY-4.0.

name: Parakeet CTC 0.6B
description: CTC-decoded Parakeet 0.6B for fast non-autoregressive, high-throughput inference. Weights CC-BY-4.0.

name: Canary 1B v2
description: NVIDIA's 1B multilingual (EN/DE/ES/FR) encoder-decoder ASR/AST model built with NeMo. Weights CC-BY-4.0.

name: FastConformer-CTC (NeMo)
description: NVIDIA's efficient Conformer-CTC English ASR; the encoder lineage behind Parakeet. Weights CC-BY-4.0.

name: wav2vec 2.0 XLS-R
description: Meta's self-supervised multilingual speech encoder (128 languages); fine-tune per language for ASR.

name: MMS 1B
description: Meta Massively Multilingual Speech: wav2vec2-based model covering 1,000+ languages. Research/non-commercial license.

name: SeamlessM4T v2
description: Meta's unified speech translation foundation (ASR + translation, 100+ languages). Non-commercial license (CC-BY-NC-4.0, confirmed in the repo LICENSE).

name: Icefall / Zipformer
description: k2-based speech recipe zoo; home of Zipformer, the parameter-efficient transducer/conformer architecture.

name: Moonshine
description: Tiny edge-first speech-to-text models with near-Whisper accuracy at a fraction of the size; built for on-device voice agents. MIT code and models (repo moved from UsefulSensors/moonshine to moonshine-ai/moonshine).

name: Deepgram
description: Real-time and batch speech-to-text API built around the Nova-3 model family, plus Flux conversational models; usage-based pricing.

name: AssemblyAI
description: Speech AI API with Universal-3.5 Pro (async and realtime) models, diarization, and audio-intelligence add-ons; usage-based pricing.

name: OpenAI Speech-to-Text API
description: Speech-to-text API with the gpt-4o-transcribe family (including gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize) and whisper-1; usage-based pricing.

name: Speechmatics
description: Speech-to-text API with Melia 1 (batch) and Linden 1 (Agent STT, real-time) models, plus on-premise options; usage-based pricing.

name: Rev AI
description: Speech-to-text API (async and streaming) with Reverb models and optional human transcription services; usage-based pricing.

name: Fireworks AI
description: Fast Whisper (v3 large/turbo) transcription API for batch and streaming audio; usage-based pricing.

name: ElevenLabs Scribe
description: Speech-to-text API with Scribe v2 (batch) and scribe_v2_realtime models, diarization and word-level timestamps; usage-based pricing.

name: Cartesia
description: Speech-to-text API with Ink models (Ink-2 streaming, ink-whisper batch) built for voice agents; usage-based pricing.

name: Gladia
description: Multilingual speech-to-text API (Solaria-1/3 models) with diarization and audio intelligence bundled in; usage-based pricing.

name: Soniox
description: Streaming and async speech-to-text API (stt-rt-v5 / stt-async-v5) with bundled diarization and translation; usage-based pricing.

name: Symbl.ai
description: Conversation-intelligence API with built-in real-time and async transcription plus summaries, entities, and sentiment; usage-based pricing.

name: Vatis Tech
description: Speech-to-text API and transcription platform with real-time and on-premise options; usage-based pricing.

name: GPT-4o audio
description: OpenAI's multimodal GPT-4o with audio input for transcription and speech understanding via the API; API-only, no open weights.

name: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
description: Google's dedicated transcription models (gemini-3.5-transcribe / transcribe-live) on the Gemini API and Vertex AI; API-only.

name: Qwen3-Omni
description: Alibaba's omni-modal LLM (text, image, audio, video) with speech-to-text ability; weights released under Apache 2.0.

name: Phi-4-multimodal
description: Microsoft's small (5.6B) multimodal model handling speech, vision, and text with strong ASR performance; released under MIT.

name: Ultravox
description: Open-weight multimodal speech LLM by Fixie that feeds audio directly into the LLM without a separate ASR stage; MIT.

name: SALMONN
description: Multimodal LLM family by ByteDance and Tsinghua for general audio understanding including speech recognition; Apache-2.0.

name: Voxtral
description: Mistral's open-weight audio LLM family for transcription and voice understanding, including a streaming Realtime variant; Apache-2.0.

name: Granite Speech
description: IBM's speech LLM for ASR and speech translation (Granite Speech 4.1 2B variants, including speaker-attributed Plus); Apache-2.0.

name: NVIDIA Canary-Qwen
description: English ASR pairing a FastConformer encoder with a Qwen LLM, with ASR-only and LLM post-processing modes (punctuation/capitalization). Weights CC-BY-4.0.

name: MERaLiON-AudioLLM
description: Whisper + SEA-LION based speech-text model by AI Singapore tuned for Singaporean accents and code-switching; custom MERaLiON public license (non-OSI).

name: whisper.cpp
description: Port of Whisper to plain C/C++ with no dependencies; runs on CPU, Metal, CUDA and Vulkan with a built-in server, and ships ggml-format models for all Whisper sizes.

name: faster-whisper
description: CTranslate2-based Whisper reimplementation: up to ~4x faster with lower memory; SYSTRAN ships ct2-converted Whisper checkpoints on Hugging Face.

name: WhisperX
description: Whisper plus VAD and wav2vec2-based forced alignment for fast, word-level-timestamped, diarizable long-form transcription.

name: NVIDIA NeMo
description: NVIDIA's scalable framework for speech AI research, training, and deployment; home of the Parakeet/Canary/FastConformer recipes and the ASR fine-tuning workflow. Repo moved from NVIDIA/NeMo to NVIDIA-NeMo/Speech.

name: SpeechBrain
description: PyTorch speech toolkit with full ASR recipes (LibriSpeech, Common Voice, multilingual) and pretrained models; recipe-first, reproducibility-focused.

name: whisper-timestamped
description: Multilingual Whisper transcription with word-level timestamps and confidence scores.

name: stable-ts
description: stable-whisper fork for transcription, forced alignment and audio indexing; the repo is archived (no longer maintained).

name: transformers
description: Hugging Face automatic-speech-recognition pipelines plus the model hub behind dozens of ASR checkpoints.

name: ESPnet
description: End-to-end speech processing toolkit covering ASR, TTS, speech translation and diarization.

name: WeNet
description: Production-oriented end-to-end speech recognition toolkit with streaming (U2/U2++) support.

name: FunASR
description: Alibaba ModelScope open-source speech toolkit: training, inference, streaming ASR, VAD, punctuation and diarization.

name: Kaldi
description: Classic HMM/DNN speech recognition toolkit; largely in maintenance mode and the predecessor of the modern stacks.

name: whisper_streaming
description: Real-time streaming transcription and translation with Whisper using a self-adaptive latency policy.

name: WhisperLive
description: Nearly-live Whisper transcription server and client communicating over websockets.

name: RealtimeSTT
description: Low-latency speech-to-text library with advanced VAD and wake-word activation.

name: Pipecat
description: Open-source framework for real-time voice agents and multimodal apps with pluggable STT services.

name: LiveKit Agents
description: Framework for building realtime voice AI agents; STT is provided via livekit-plugins-* packages (Deepgram, OpenAI, etc.).

name: Silero STT
description: Small streaming-capable pre-trained STT models; the repo LICENSE is CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial).

name: sherpa-onnx
description: On-device speech-to-text (plus TTS, diarization, VAD, enhancement) via ONNX Runtime, including streaming and edge builds.

name: Vosk
description: Offline speech recognition API for Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi and servers with small-footprint models.

name: WhisperKit
description: On-device Whisper inference via Core ML for Apple platforms (Swift); repo renamed from argmaxinc/whisperkit to argmax-oss-swift.

name: mlx-whisper
description: Apple MLX port of Whisper for Apple Silicon, shipped as an example in mlx-examples (also a pip package); the star count is the parent repo's.

name: LibriSpeech
description: The canonical ~960-hour read-speech benchmark of audiobook recordings; the default WER touchstone for ASR research, including LLM-era systems. Paper: arXiv 1504.04374.

name: FLEURS
description: Google's massively multilingual speech benchmark covering 102 languages, used to evaluate the multilingual ability of speech models. Paper: arXiv 2205.12446.

name: Earnings-21
description: ~39 hours of US earnings calls released by Rev for ASR benchmarking; a real-world spontaneous-speech eval set. Paper: arXiv 2104.11348.

name: Earnings-22
description: ~119 hours of accented global earnings calls (125 files) released by Rev for domain-robustness ASR evaluation. Paper: arXiv 2203.15591.

name: Common Voice
description: Mozilla's crowdsourced multilingual speech corpus (v27.0, ~295 locales), a workhorse training and evaluation source for open ASR; downloads moved to the Mozilla Data Collective. CC0 public domain.

name: TED-LIUM 3
description: 452 hours of TED-talk recordings for ASR evaluation, a standard long-form prepared-speech benchmark. Note the restrictive license. Paper: arXiv 1805.04699.

name: VoxPopuli
description: Meta's multilingual corpus: 100K hours of unlabeled speech (23 languages) plus 1.8K hours of transcribed speech (16 languages). License terms vary by subset; the transcribed ASR subset is distributed under CC0 per the HF ESB card. Paper: arXiv 2101.00390.

name: GigaSpeech
description: 10,000 hours of transcribed English speech from audiobooks, podcasts and YouTube — one of the largest open ASR corpora. Licensing caveat: the repo is tagged Apache-2.0 but actual access is restricted to non-commercial research use; check terms before use.

name: Open ASR Leaderboard
description: The Hugging Face community leaderboard for ASR models, run with NVIDIA, Mistral and Cambridge: 60+ models ranked across 11+ datasets in English, multilingual and long-form tracks.

name: SUPERB
description: The frozen-self-supervised-learning speech benchmark, probing how well upstream representations serve downstream tasks including ASR. Paper: arXiv 2105.01051.

name: ML-SUPERB
description: The multilingual extension of SUPERB, benchmarking self-supervised speech representations across many languages. Paper: arXiv 2305.10615.

name: AudioBench
description: A universal benchmark for audio-capable LLMs across speech, sound and music understanding — the audio-LLM-era eval standard. Paper: arXiv 2406.16020.

name: Lhotse
description: The next-generation Kaldi-style speech data-preparation library: efficient, iterable corpus management for large-scale ASR training. Paper: arXiv 2110.12561.

name: Fine-Tune Whisper (Hugging Face guide)
description: Hugging Face's official end-to-end guide to fine-tuning Whisper for multilingual ASR with Transformers — the standard starting point for Whisper adaptation.

name: SLAM-LLM
description: The canonical implementation of the SLAM-ASR recipe: an encoder-adapter-LLM design that wires speech encoders into frozen LLMs for strong ASR. Paper: arXiv 2402.08846.

name: pyannote.audio
description: The standard open-source neural speaker diarization toolkit, currently v4. Code is MIT; the pretrained segmentation/embedding pipelines on Hugging Face are gated under custom terms, so check before commercial use.

name: WeSpeaker
description: WeNet's speaker verification and diarization toolkit with pretrained models for embeddings, VAD and clustering pipelines.

name: 3D-Speaker
description: ModelScope's speaker toolkit for diarization, verification and multi-speaker ASR, supporting multi-device and multi-channel scenarios.

name: deep-multilingual-punctuation
description: Python library that restores punctuation and sentence segmentation to raw ASR transcripts (English, German, French, Italian), built on the FullStop model for spoken language.

name: Montreal Forced Aligner
description: The standard open-source forced aligner, producing word- and phone-level timestamps needed for subtitling and ASR postprocessing.

name: aeneas
description: Forced aligner focused on synchronizing audio with text to generate subtitles and audio-book timings; widely used in ASR postprocessing pipelines. Note the AGPL license.
